program.name: Pure PPL: 6-Day Push Pull Legs
program.description: The gold-standard high-frequency split for dedicated lifters, hitting each muscle group twice weekly with optimal volume distribution.
guidelines: Workout order: Push 1, Pull 1, Legs 1, Push 2, Pull 2, Legs 2, Rest.
Workout 1 days emphasize heavy compound loading; Workout 2 days emphasize hypertrophy variation and pump.
Leave 1–2 clean reps in reserve on early sets; take the final set of accessories to technical failure.
Ensure high daily calorie and protein intake to support 6 days of training.

workouts.title: Chest & Delts
workouts.focus: Horizontal pressing power, overhead strength, and triceps

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
cues: Lie with eyes under bar; plant feet firmly and pin shoulder blades down and back into bench.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder-width; unrack and stabilize directly over shoulders.
Lower bar in a slight arc to mid-to-lower sternum, tucking elbows at 45–70°.
Press bar explosively upward and slightly back toward your face, finishing over shoulders.
avoid: Flaring elbows out at 90 degrees to torso (causes subacromial impingement).
Bouncing bar off ribcage or lifting glutes off bench.
Letting wrists bend completely backward under bar.

exercises.name: Standing Barbell Overhead Press
cues: Grip bar just outside shoulders; rest bar on front delts with forearms vertical and elbows slightly forward.
Squeeze glutes, quads, and abs to create an immovable base.
Pull chin back slightly to clear bar path; press bar in a straight vertical line overhead.
Push head forward once bar clears forehead; lock out bar directly over mid-foot with a slight trap shrug.
avoid: Arching lower back excessively (leaning back to turn it into an incline press).
Dipping knees to initiate press (this is a strict press, not a push press).
Pressing bar in a wide, looping forward arc around head.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cues: Set bench to 30 degrees; retract shoulder blades and plant feet firmly on floor.
Lower dumbbells under control to sides of upper chest, elbows angled at 45–60°.
Feel a deep stretch across upper pectorals at the bottom with forearms vertical.
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward over upper chest without clanking them together.
avoid: Arching lower back excessively to turn the press into a flat bench press.
Flaring elbows perpendicular to torso.
Banging dumbbells together at top of rep.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
cues: Set pulley at knee or wrist height; stand tall with cable crossing in front or behind body.
Raise arm out and slightly forward in the scapular plane (~30° in front of torso).
Lead with elbow until arm reaches parallel to floor, keeping wrist neutral.
Pause for a split second at peak contraction, then lower under 2–3 second control.
avoid: Swinging torso or using leg bounce to initiate the movement.
Shrugging neck and upper traps up toward ears to lift the cable.
Internally rotating shoulder ('pouring a pitcher of water') during the raise.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pressdown
cues: Stand tall with a slight forward torso lean; pin elbows firmly against sides of ribcage.
Grip rope with neutral hands; press straight down until elbows are fully extended.
Spread rope ends apart at full lockout, squeezing triceps hard for 1 second.
Allow forearms to rise past 90 degrees toward chest under control for a deep triceps stretch.
avoid: Cutting off the eccentric stretch by stopping artificially at 90 degrees elbow flexion.
Allowing elbows to swing forward and backward during the rep.
Leaning bodyweight down on top of rope to push with chest and shoulders.

workouts.title: Deadlift & Back
workouts.focus: Posterior chain strength, lat width, and biceps mass

exercises.name: Conventional Barbell Deadlift
cues: Set feet hip-width with bar over mid-foot (1 inch from shins); grip just outside legs.
Pull chest tall, engage lats ('protect armpits'), and pull the slack out of the barbell.
Push floor away through mid-foot, keeping bar dragging up shins and thighs.
Stand tall and lock out with glutes; do not lean backward at the top.
avoid: Rounding the lumbar spine under load.
Jerking the barbell off floor without pulling slack first.
Hyperextending lower back at lockout instead of squeezing glutes.
Letting bar drift forward away from legs.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
cues: Adjust thigh pads securely over legs; grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lean torso back slightly (10–15 degrees) with chest proud and shoulder blades depressed.
Drive elbows straight down toward your front hip pockets, pulling bar to upper chest.
Squeeze lats at bottom, then control bar up into a full overhead stretch.
avoid: Leaning back excessively (turning the pulldown into a sloppy horizontal row).
Driving elbows far behind torso instead of pulling down in front.
Pulling bar behind neck or yanking down to stomach.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
cues: Hinge at hips with torso angled at ~45 degrees, lower back flat, knees softly bent.
Take an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width, bar hanging over mid-foot.
Drive elbows back behind torso, pulling bar toward lower abdomen / belly button.
Squeeze shoulder blades together at top, then lower bar under control into full stretch.
avoid: Jerking torso upright to heave weight (turning row into a standing shrug).
Rounding lumbar or thoracic spine under load.
Letting shoulders roll forward at the bottom of the rep.

exercises.name: Face Pull
cues: Set cable pulley to eye level with rope attachment; grip rope with thumbs pointing backward.
Step back into an athletic staggered stance with core braced and ribs pulled down.
Pull center of rope toward forehead while driving elbows high and wide.
Rotate hands back past ears into full external rotation, squeezing rear delts and upper back.
avoid: Craning head and neck forward to meet the rope.
Leaning backward or hyperextending lumbar spine to heave the weight.
Allowing elbows to drop below wrist level (internal rotation fault).

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cues: Set bench to 55–60 degrees; sit back with head and torso supported by pad.
Let arms hang straight down toward floor, keeping upper arms strictly vertical.
Curl dumbbells upward, supinating wrists (palms up) as you ascend into a hard bicep peak.
Lower under strict 2–3 second control into a deep, full stretch at the bottom.
avoid: Swinging upper arms or elbows forward to bypass the bottom stretch.
Lifting head or shoulders off bench pad during the curl.
Cutting the eccentric stretch short.

workouts.title: Squat & Hams
workouts.focus: Heavy quad squat loading, hamstring hinge, and core

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
cues: Set bar firmly on upper traps/shelf; pull bar down into back to engage lats.
Take a 360° diaphragmatic breath into abdomen; break at hips and knees simultaneously.
Descend until hip crease dips below top of knee, knees tracking in line with toes.
Drive through mid-foot with chest and hips rising at the exact same rate.
avoid: Knees caving inward (valgus collapse) on ascent.
Hips shooting up first ('good-morning' squat), shifting load onto lower back.
Rounding or hyperextending lumbar spine at the bottom.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Stand tall with a shoulder-width grip, lats engaged to keep bar pinned against thighs.
Soften knees slightly and lock that knee angle in place throughout the rep.
Push hips straight back horizontally as if reaching for a wall behind you.
Stop descent once hips stop moving backward (usually mid-shin), then drive hips forward.
avoid: Rounding lower back to reach the floor once hips have stopped traveling back.
Bending knees further into a squat, shifting tension away from hamstrings.
Allowing bar to drift forward away from legs.

exercises.name: Leg Press
cues: Place feet shoulder-width on center of platform, knees in line with toes.
Pull seat handles firmly to anchor your hips and lower back flat against back pad.
Lower sled under control as deep as hip mobility allows without pelvis curling off pad.
Press platform away through mid-foot, stopping just short of a harsh knee lockout.
avoid: Pelvis tucking under or lower back rounding off the back pad ('butt wink').
Forcefully hyperextending or snapping knee joints locked at the top.
Knees caving inward during the descent or initial press.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
cues: Align machine pivot point directly with your knee joints; adjust shin pad just above ankles.
Grip side handles firmly to lock hips and pelvis down into the seat throughout the set.
Extend knees smoothly and hold a peak quad squeeze for 1 full second at top.
Lower under strict 2–3 second eccentric control through full range of motion.
avoid: Hips lifting off the seat pad or using torso momentum to kick the weight up.
Letting the weight stack slam between reps.

exercises.name: Standing Machine Calf Raise
cues: Place balls of feet on edge of block, shoulder-width; keep knees straight with a micro-bend.
Lower heels as deep as ankle mobility allows; hold a full 2-second stretch at the bottom.
Drive up forcefully through the balls of feet, focusing pressure through the big toes.
Squeeze calves hard at peak contraction for 1 second before descending.
avoid: Bouncing out of bottom stretch (relies on Achilles tendon elasticity instead of muscle).
Bending and extending knees to heave weight up (turning it into a squat).
Rolling ankles outward onto pinky toes.

exercises.name: Kneeling Cable Crunch
cues: Kneel facing cable; glue rope handles to sides of forehead/ears with hands fixed.
Keep hips high and stationary throughout; do not let hips sit back toward heels.
Flex spine to curl ribcage down toward pelvis, pulling elbows toward upper thighs.
Squeeze abs hard at peak contraction, then resist cable back into a full torso extension.
avoid: Sitting hips back onto heels during crunch (shifts load to hip flexors).
Pulling rope with arms or lats instead of flexing spine with abs.
Keeping spine straight and hinging at hips.

workouts.title: Upper Chest
workouts.focus: Incline pressing, lateral shoulder volume, and pec fly pump

exercises.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
cues: Set bench to 30 degrees; plant feet firmly and pin shoulder blades into pad.
Grip slightly wider than shoulder width; unrack bar directly over upper chest.
Lower under control to upper chest/sternum (just below collarbones) with elbows at ~45–60°.
Press bar up and slightly back to full extension over upper chest.
avoid: Bouncing bar off collarbones or ribcage.
Flaring elbows out wide to 90 degrees.
Arching lower back excessively (which flattens the torso and eliminates incline angle).

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cues: Retract shoulder blades into bench, plant feet firmly, and hold dumbbells over chest.
Lower dumbbells with control, maintaining vertical forearms and elbows tucked at 45–60°.
Lower into a deep, comfortable chest stretch at bottom without shoulder discomfort.
Press dumbbells up and slightly inward in a smooth arc, stopping just short of touching.
avoid: Clanking dumbbells together at top (removes muscular tension from pecs).
Flaring elbows perpendicular to torso ('T' position).
Allowing forearms to angle inward or outward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
cues: Stand tall with a slight forward torso hinge (10–15°) and dumbbells at your sides.
Raise dumbbells outward toward walls in the scapular plane (~30° in front of torso).
Lead slightly with elbows until arms are parallel to floor; keep wrists neutral.
Hold peak contraction for a split second, then lower under strict control.
avoid: Shrugging upper traps toward ears to heave the dumbbells up.
Rocking torso back and forth or using hip thrust for momentum.
Internally rotating wrists/shoulders at top (thumbs pointed down).

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly
cues: Adjust seat height so handles align with mid-chest; plant feet firmly on floor.
Set a slight, fixed bend in elbows (~15°) and keep chest proud against back pad.
Bring handles together in a wide hugging arc, focusing on squeezing inner biceps together over sternum.
Return under control to a deep pectoral stretch, stopping before shoulders roll forward.
avoid: Letting elbows travel too far behind torso, hyperextending anterior shoulder capsule.
Shrugging upper traps or rolling shoulders forward at peak contraction.
Bending elbows excessively to turn the fly into a chest press.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
cues: Set pulley at head/shoulder height; face away in a stable staggered split stance.
Position upper arms alongside ears and forward (~45°), keeping elbows fixed in place.
Extend forearms forward in a straight line until elbows are fully locked out.
Bend elbows under control, letting rope travel behind head into a deep long-head stretch.
avoid: Hyperextending lower back to assist the press (keep ribs down and core braced).
Flaring elbows excessively wide outward during extension.
Moving upper arms back and forth instead of pivoting strictly at elbow joint.

workouts.title: Lats & Biceps
workouts.focus: Bodyweight pulling, horizontal row volume, and arm thickness

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
cues: Hang with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders in a full dead hang.
Initiate pull by depressing shoulder blades down and back ('pull shoulders into back pockets').
Drive elbows down toward floor, pulling upper chest toward bar until chin clears bar.
Lower under strict control back into a full dead hang before starting next rep.
avoid: Kipping, swinging legs, or using hip momentum to clear the bar.
Craning neck upward to touch bar while chest collapses.
Performing half reps by failing to lock out into a dead hang at bottom.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cues: Place same-side knee and hand firmly on flat bench; keep spine flat and hips square to floor.
Let dumbbell hang directly below shoulder, feeling a full lat stretch at bottom.
Pull dumbbell back toward hip crease in a sweeping arc, driving elbow toward ceiling.
Squeeze lat at top, then lower dumbbell under control into full extension.
avoid: Twisting or rotating torso at the top of the pull to heave the weight.
Rounding lower back during the stretch phase.
Pulling straight up to chest like a bicep curl rather than arcing back to hip.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
cues: Set bench to a 30–45 degree incline; rest chest firmly against pad with feet planted.
Allow dumbbells to hang straight down at full arm extension, letting shoulder blades stretch open.
Drive elbows back toward hips, retracting shoulder blades firmly at peak contraction.
Lower dumbbells under control into a deep, full back stretch without chest lifting.
avoid: Heaving chest off bench pad to generate momentum.
Craning neck upward toward ceiling.
Pulling with arms/biceps instead of driving through elbows and scapulae.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
cues: Stand tall holding dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
Keep elbows pinned close to ribs; curl dumbbells upward in line with shoulders.
Squeeze brachialis and forearms intensely at top of rep.
Lower dumbbells under strict control to full arm extension without swinging.
avoid: Rocking hips or swinging torso to initiate curl.
Flaring elbows out to sides.
Letting wrists flex or curl inward.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Curl
cues: Grip the angled camber of the EZ-bar with palms facing upward and wrists comfortable.
Pin elbows to your sides and brace core; stand tall with knees soft.
Curl bar upward in a smooth arc toward shoulders, squeezing biceps hard at the top.
Lower bar under strict control to full elbow extension without swinging torso.
avoid: Leaning back or hyperextending lumbar spine to heave the weight up.
Swinging elbows far forward to turn curl into a shoulder raise.
Cutting bottom range of motion short before full extension.

workouts.title: Legs & Abs
workouts.focus: Anterior quad loading, unilateral balance, and calf specialization

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
cues: Rest bar on front deltoids with fingertip clean grip (or cross-arm grip), elbows high and parallel to floor.
Maintain a vertical torso and brace core tightly throughout descent.
Squat between your knees to full comfortable depth, tracking knees forward over toes.
Drive floor away through mid-foot while keeping elbows driven high.
avoid: Elbows dropping downward, causing upper back to round and bar to dump forward.
Heels lifting off floor or weight shifting excessively onto toes.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
cues: Place laces of rear foot on bench; step front foot forward into a balanced split stance.
Maintain a slight forward torso lean (~15°) with a braced, neutral spine.
Descend until back knee hovers an inch above the floor, front knee tracking over toes.
Drive straight up through the whole front foot (tripod foot: heel, big toe, pinky toe).
avoid: Front heel lifting off floor or front knee caving inward (valgus collapse).
Pushing aggressively off rear foot instead of loading the front working leg.
Hyperextending lower back by trying to stay unnaturally upright.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
cues: Adjust backrest so knee joints align with machine pivot; lock thigh pad tightly over lower quads.
Position ankle pad against lower calves/Achilles; keep toes neutral or slightly dorsiflexed.
Drive heels down and back underneath seat into full knee flexion, pausing for 1 second.
Resist the return under control, feeling a deep stretch at full knee extension.
avoid: Loose thigh pad allowing thighs or hips to lift during curl.
Cutting range of motion short at either top stretch or bottom flexion.
Leaning torso far back during the pull.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
cues: Align knee joints with machine pivot point; position pad on lower calf just above Achilles.
Grip handles firmly to pull your hips and pelvis flat into the bench.
Curl heels toward glutes in a smooth arc, holding a brief contraction at peak.
Lower under strict 2–3 second control into full knee extension without slamming stack.
avoid: Hips popping off bench pad or arching lower back to heave weight.
Using ballistic momentum or kicking weights up quickly.

exercises.name: Seated Machine Calf Raise
cues: Sit with balls of feet on platform; adjust thigh pad firmly over lower quads (above knees).
Lower heels down into a deep calf stretch; hold the bottom stretch for 2 full seconds.
Press platform away through balls of feet into full plantarflexion.
Squeeze soleus hard at peak height for 1 second before controlling descent.
avoid: Bouncing off Achilles tendon at the bottom of the rep.
Cutting range of motion into short, twitchy half-reps.
Setting thigh pad too high up on mid-thighs, causing instability.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
cues: Hang from bar with an overhand grip, engaging shoulders down and back (active hang).
Squeeze legs together; curl pelvis upward toward chest as knees rise.
Pause for 1 second at top contraction with knees at chest level.
Lower knees under control to a dead stop before starting next rep.
avoid: Swinging legs or using hip momentum to kick knees up.
Arching lower back at the bottom of the rep.
Hanging passively with relaxed shoulders shrugged to ears.
